text: Sorry it's so late, been up with him for hours. My son's 22 months. His body's hot, but his hands and feet are freezing cold and he's been shivering on and off, even with a blanket on. Doesn't make sense to me. Nappies are wet so he's weeing normally. He's also got a few bites on his legs he keeps scratching, but that's from the weekend. Just not sure what to make of the cold hands and feet.
